eps.ov: A pair of mysterious voices lead 14-year-old Ai Ohto to a strange egg, promising her a chance at what she wants most. What's inside the egg? And what does Ai really want?
eps.oa: يقود صوتان غامضان «آي أوتو» ذات الأربعة عشر عاماً إلى بيضة غريبة، ويعدانها بفرصة لنيل أكثر ما تريده. فما الذي في البيضة؟ وما الذي تريده آي حقاً؟

eps.ov: Ai meets Neiru, another girl who is buying Eggs. She's given the cold shoulder at first, but could that change after the next time they crack their Eggs? Assuming they make it back alive, that is.
eps.oa: تلقى «آي» «نيرو»، فتاة أخرى تشتري «البيض». وتلقى منها في البداية جفاء، لكن أيتغير ذلك بعد أن تكسرا بيضهما في المرة القادمة؟ هذا إن عادتا حيتين.

eps.ov: While buying Eggs for herself and Neiru, Ai meets Rika, a former idol who is there for the same reason. Rika quickly pushes her way into Ai's life, but what lies beneath her cheerful and callous exterior?
eps.oa: بينما تشتري «آي» «البيض» لنفسها ولـ«نيرو»، تلقى «ريكا»، الأيدول السابقة التي جاءت للسبب نفسه. وسرعان ما تقتحم ريكا حياة آي، لكن ما الذي يكمن تحت ظاهرها المرح القاسي؟

eps.ov: With Rika out of action, Ai is on the run and struggling to protect two girls from the most devious killer she's faced yet. Meanwhile, a fourth child is also fighting to protect the girls in the Eggs.
eps.oa: خرجت «ريكا» من المعركة، فتجد «آي» نفسها هاربة تكافح لتحمي فتاتين من أمكر قاتل واجهته حتى الآن. وفي الأثناء يكافح شخص رابع هو الآخر ليحمي الفتيات في «البيض».

eps.ov: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe are quickly becoming close friends as they continue to protect Eggs. But as they grow closer, questions pile up and tensions rise.
eps.oa: سرعان ما تصير «آي» و«نيرو» و«ريكا» و«موموي» صديقات مقربات وهن يواصلن حماية «البيض». لكن كلما تقاربن تراكمت الأسئلة وتصاعد التوتر.

eps.ov: The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs. Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.
eps.oa: يهاجم الفتياتِ نوعٌ جديد خطر من الأعداء وهن يحاولن حماية «بيضات العجائب». وقد يكون لدى «أكا» و«أورا-أكا» حل، لكن «آي» أشد انشغالاً بالعلاقة الناشئة بين أمها والأستاذ «ساواكي».

eps.ov: It’s Rika's birthday, and the girls get together to celebrate. Rika, however, is focused on her troubled relationship with her mother, and those worries carry over into her next battle. Will she be able to overcome her inner demons in time?
Acca and Ura-Acca would like to sell you a Wonder Egg. While you make up your mind, they'll explain the Eggs and introduce four of their regular customers: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe.

The girls are surprised when Neiru invites them all to her house, and even more surprised to find out that she lives at her company. Is Neiru ready to be open about her situation, and how will the others take it if she is?
Ai, Rika, and Neiru confront Acca and Ura-Acca, but are distracted by shocking news from Momoe. Later, Momoe confronts her toughest battle yet while Ai makes a difficult decision.
The girls realize that there's more waiting for them at the end of missions than they bargained for. As doubts pile up and tensions rise, Ura-Acca decides to tell Ai his story.

Friendships are tested as Ai and Neiru realize how much "victory" has cost Rika and Momoe. Ai decides to fight again in spite of what she's learned, but the girl who emerges from her Egg this time may be more than she bargained for.
